*Kusalattika, Micchattaniyatattika* (Patthana 17.14) is an Abhidhamma text in the canonical Pali *Paṭṭhāna*. The text analyzes the conditional relations arising from the intersection of the wholesome triad (*kusalattika*) and the triad of fixed destiny (*micchattaniyatattika*).
